user_query: I'm a fashion enthusiast and I'm looking for trendy clothing items. Can you show me the latest fashion products available on AliExpress? Also, provide me with the prices and customer feedback for these products. Furthermore, I'd like to know the categories these products belong to.

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest fashion products from AliExpress.
Retrieve the prices for the fetched fashion products.
Gather customer feedback for the fetched fashion products.
Identify the categories for the fetched fashion products.
